name: Animated financial chart
purpose: Full-featured financial chart composition containing Catmull-Rom spline curves, closed area gradients, data point telemetry, and threshold markers.

inputs.name: points
inputs.description: Array of numerical data points or {x, y} coordinates

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: Chart type: line, area, candlesticks, gauge

implementation.api: Studio.comp.animatedChart(parent, { points, type, color, fill, telemetry })

layout_notes: Expands to fill 100% of parent viewport stage while preserving aspect-ratio-safe coordinate grids.

validation.evidence: Tested and verified in tests/test-motion-primitives Scene 1 with 8-point Shanghai Composite surge.
